Badge Generator

Design CSS badges and pills — colors, sizes, shapes — with live preview and copy-ready HTML/CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Type the badge text and pick background and text colors.
  2. Choose size, corner style and options like uppercase or a dot.
  3. Preview the badge live.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained badge.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is text contrast handled?

Pick colors manually, or tick "auto text color" to choose white or black based on background luminance.

What sizes are available?

Small, medium and large — each with tuned padding and font size.

Can I embed it in my page?

Copy the markup and the <style> block. The class is .bdg-badge, unlikely to collide.

What is the dot option?

A small status dot before the text — handy for online/offline indicators.
